item.subject: science
item.stem:
Padma stands at the same small distance in front of three mirrors at a science exhibition. The diagram summarises the image of her face in each mirror.

Which identification is correct?

options.A: P is plane, Q is concave, R is convex
options.B: P is convex, Q is plane, R is concave
options.C: All three must be plane mirrors because every image is erect
options.D: Q is convex because a larger image always means a wider view
